raw_text: Cache synchronous, expensive `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, and `document.cookie` reads in memory. Use a Map (not a hook) so it works everywhere: utilities, event handlers, not just React components. Keep cache in sync after writes. **Important (invalidate on external changes):** If storage can change externally (another tab, server-set cookies), invalidate cache.
